fcntl.limit: Cover the listed descriptor queries and duplication command. Use F_ADD_SEALS only within private executable-image and scratch-file preparation.

commands.name: F_GETFD
commands.scope: Reads descriptor flags of a borrowed descriptor.

commands.name: F_GETFL
commands.scope: Reads the access mode and file status flags of a borrowed descriptor.

commands.name: F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC
commands.scope: Duplicates a descriptor at or above the requested minimum with FD_CLOEXEC set atomically.

commands.name: F_ADD_SEALS
commands.scope: Seal the private executable memfd before exposing its owned descriptor. Independently, the scratch-file page preparation uses this selector on a private non-executable memfd before mapping it read-only.

ioctl.limit: The generic unread-byte query uses the Linux C int output ABI. Three other requests run only for the private pseudoterminal created in the scoped hangup operation.

commands.name: FIONREAD
commands.scope: Reads an unread-byte observation from a descriptor implementing FIONREAD. The native observation is tested on pipes.

commands.name: TIOCSPTLCK
commands.scope: Unlock the exact private master with an integer zero.

commands.name: TIOCGPTPEER
commands.scope: Open the exact private master's slave with fixed close-on-exec and no-controlling-terminal flags.

commands.name: TIOCSCTTY
commands.scope: Attach the exact provider-owned slave as controlling terminal for the caller's new session with argument zero.

prctl.limit: Support querying and setting no_new_privs and the typed current-thread name accessors. Other command and pointer layouts are unsupported.

commands.name: PR_GET_NO_NEW_PRIVS
commands.scope: Returns the observed Boolean state of no_new_privs for the current thread.

commands.name: PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS
commands.scope: Set no_new_privs to one for the calling thread. Existing sibling threads keep their own state.

commands.name: PR_GET_NAME
commands.scope: Read the current thread name into checked 16-byte native storage.

commands.name: PR_SET_NAME
commands.scope: Set only the calling thread name after validating a maximum of 15 name bytes.

bpf.limit: Only three commands for one fixed U32-keyed U64-valued plain ARRAY profile are covered. All other map and command variants are unsupported.

commands.name: BPF_MAP_CREATE
commands.scope: Create a plain array with between 1 and 1024 elements.

commands.name: BPF_MAP_LOOKUP_ELEM
commands.scope: Read one entry using a typed index and initialized output slot.

commands.name: BPF_MAP_UPDATE_ELEM
commands.scope: Write one typed value at a validated index with the normal array update mode.

perf_event_open.limit: Admit the fixed software task-clock event and the scoped return probe. The return probe uses a runtime-discovered native uprobe PMU type and fixed return-event config for one provider-owned function in the calling thread.

commands.name: PERF_COUNT_SW_TASK_CLOCK
commands.scope: The event type is PERF_TYPE_SOFTWARE with a fixed unsampled ungrouped attribute profile.

commands.name: UPROBE_RETPROBE
commands.scope: Use config bit zero with the kernel-published uprobe PMU type, a fixed provider function and one thread-scoped unsampled event.

io_uring_setup.limit: Setup uses zero flags and a bounded queue depth. Mapping and all feature-specific variants are unsupported.

commands.name: FLAGS_ZERO
commands.scope: Fixed flag-free setup parameter profile with 1 through 256 requested submission entries.

io_uring_enter.limit: Support one synchronous pointer-free NOP on a fresh private ring. Other submission opcodes, enter flags and layouts are outside this profile.

commands.name: IORING_ENTER_GETEVENTS
commands.scope: Submit one IORING_OP_NOP and request one completion, with no extended argument or caller pointers.

io_uring_register.limit: Only capability probing with a private bounded buffer is covered.

commands.name: IORING_REGISTER_PROBE
commands.scope: Query capabilities and expose only the initialized opcode record prefix.

getsockopt.limit: Observe only the two listed SOL_SOCKET options. Other levels and pointer layouts require separate contracts.

commands.name: SO_TYPE
commands.scope: Read the C int socket type at level SOL_SOCKET.

commands.name: SO_REUSEADDR
commands.scope: Read the address reuse flag using one C int at level SOL_SOCKET.

setsockopt.limit: Set only a Boolean SO_REUSEADDR at level SOL_SOCKET.

commands.name: SO_REUSEADDR
commands.scope: Set the address reuse flag through one C int set to zero or one.

membarrier.limit: Support the fixed query command only. Registering and executing memory barriers are outside this profile.

commands.name: MEMBARRIER_CMD_QUERY
commands.scope: Observe the supported command bitmask using zero flags.

personality.limit: Support only the sentinel that observes the calling task personality.

commands.name: QUERY_ONLY
commands.scope: Observe the current ABI personality flags without changing them. QUERY_ONLY is the profile name for the Linux 0xffffffff sentinel.

setfsuid.limit: The profile supports only the fixed sentinel that observes the caller's filesystem user ID.

commands.name: QUERY_ONLY
commands.scope: QUERY_ONLY identifies the Linux all-ones argument, which returns the previous filesystem user ID without modifying it.

setfsgid.limit: The profile supports only the fixed sentinel that observes the caller's filesystem group ID.

commands.name: QUERY_ONLY
commands.scope: QUERY_ONLY identifies the Linux all-ones argument, which returns the previous filesystem group ID without modifying it.

semctl.limit: Allow bounded per-value observation and update and owned set removal. Other native union arguments and commands remain outside the profile.

commands.name: GETVAL
commands.scope: Observe one indexed value in the owned set.

commands.name: SETVAL
commands.scope: Set one indexed value through the native scalar argument.

commands.name: IPC_RMID
commands.scope: Remove the owned semaphore set with recoverable failure.

msgctl.limit: Allow only owned queue removal. Status, tuning and externally supplied identifiers are outside the profile.

commands.name: IPC_RMID
commands.scope: Consume an owned SysV message queue on successful removal.

shmctl.limit: Allow bounded status observation and removal of a private segment. Other commands and externally supplied identifiers are outside the profile.

commands.name: IPC_STAT
commands.scope: Observe selected fields from the native shmid64_ds record.

commands.name: IPC_RMID
commands.scope: Mark an owned segment for deletion while preserving attachment lifetime.

landlock_create_ruleset.limit: Observe the advertised ABI or allocate only the ABI 1 filesystem-read ruleset profile.

commands.name: LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION
commands.scope: Observe the supported ABI version with no attributes.

commands.name: FLAGS_ZERO
commands.scope: Create the fixed filesystem-read ruleset with the version 1 attribute prefix and no flags.

landlock_add_rule.limit: Support only the fixed PATH_BENEATH native rule record and filesystem-read right selectors.

commands.name: LANDLOCK_RULE_PATH_BENEATH
commands.scope: Add one read allow rule for a borrowed filesystem object.

io_submit.limit: Submit one stable control block per call using the typed fsync or private-pipe poll profile. The selected profile governs cancellation and completion in the owned context.

commands.name: IOCB_CMD_FSYNC
commands.scope: Submit one bounded asynchronous fsync using an owned context and a borrowed descriptor.

commands.name: IOCB_CMD_POLL
commands.scope: Submit one native POLLIN request on the reader of a fresh private empty pipe. The context retains both pipe endpoints until validated completion or successful destruction.

openat2.limit: The package uses one fixed open_how resolution profile and lets Linux validate the declared open flags and mode.

commands.name: RESOLVE_BENEATH_NO_MAGICLINKS
commands.scope: Combine RESOLVE_BENEATH and RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS. Pass open flags and mode unchanged.

lsm_get_self_attr.limit: Only the read-only LSM_ATTR_CURRENT native selector is admitted. Other attributes and flags are outside this profile.

commands.name: LSM_ATTR_CURRENT
commands.scope: Read the calling thread's current context records and preserve opaque module bytes.

seccomp.limit: Support action and notification-layout observation only. Installing filters and creating listeners are outside this profile.

commands.name: SECCOMP_GET_ACTION_AVAIL
commands.scope: Observe native support for one selected typed action.

commands.name: SECCOMP_GET_NOTIF_SIZES
commands.scope: Observe exact native notification record sizes.

statmount.limit: Support one current-namespace query of basic mount metadata. Other masks and namespace selectors are outside this profile.

commands.name: STATMOUNT_MNT_BASIC
commands.scope: Request basic identifying fields and native flags for the selected mount.

get_mempolicy.limit: Support observing the calling thread, its allowed node mask, or one tracked owned mapping. Other flag combinations and arbitrary addresses are outside this profile.

commands.name: FLAGS_ZERO
commands.scope: Observe the calling thread's NUMA policy.

commands.name: MPOL_F_ADDR
commands.scope: Observe the NUMA policy for one tracked owned anonymous mapping.

commands.name: MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED
commands.scope: Observe the calling thread's allowed node mask.

close_range.limit: Set close-on-exec in one inclusive descriptor range. Closing and descriptor-table unsharing are outside this profile.

commands.name: CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC
commands.scope: Mark currently open descriptor entries without closing them.

futex.limit: The legacy entry supports only private U32 wait and wake. Other opcodes and arbitrary futex addresses are outside this profile.

commands.name: FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE
commands.scope: Wait on one borrowed private atomic word, with an optional relative timeout.

commands.name: FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE
commands.scope: Wake up to the admitted count on one borrowed private atomic word.

open_tree.limit: Clone one active tracked tmpfs anchor into an owned detached descriptor. Other paths and recursive clone profiles are unsupported.

commands.name: CLONE_CLOEXEC_EMPTY_PATH
commands.scope: Use OPEN_TREE_CLONE, OPEN_TREE_CLOEXEC and AT_EMPTY_PATH on the owned root descriptor.

fspick.limit: Acquire one configuration context for an active tracked tmpfs. Reconfiguration is outside this profile.

commands.name: CLOEXEC_EMPTY_PATH
commands.scope: Use FSPICK_CLOEXEC and FSPICK_EMPTY_PATH on the owned root descriptor.

mount_setattr.limit: Add only read-only and no-symlink-follow attributes to one active tracked tmpfs.

commands.name: RDONLY_NOSYMFOLLOW
commands.scope: Use AT_EMPTY_PATH and the version-zero record with both listed attribute bits set and all other fields zero.

keyctl.limit: Support only anonymous session installation and exact owned user-key read and unlink. Other selectors or external serials are outside this profile.

commands.name: KEYCTL_JOIN_SESSION_KEYRING
commands.scope: Install a fresh anonymous session and return an opaque thread-affine authority.

commands.name: KEYCTL_UNLINK
commands.scope: Unlink only the exact owned key from its anonymous session.

commands.name: KEYCTL_READ
commands.scope: Read the whole tracked key into bounded private storage or report the required capacity.

syslog.limit: Observe only native kernel log buffer capacity. Log content and control actions are outside this profile.

commands.name: SYSLOG_ACTION_SIZE_BUFFER
commands.scope: Query capacity in bytes with a null buffer and length zero.

sysfs.limit: Observe only the filesystem type count through the legacy syscall.

commands.name: GET_COUNT
commands.scope: Use native operation three with both remaining arguments zero.

mlockall.limit: Support one on-fault locking request for current mappings of the calling address space.

commands.name: MCL_CURRENT_ONFAULT
commands.scope: Request the MCL_CURRENT and MCL_ONFAULT flag pair without MCL_FUTURE.

fanotify_init.limit: Create one nonblocking privileged FAN_CLASS_NOTIF instance with close-on-exec on the group and on delivered files.

commands.name: CLASS_NOTIF_CLOEXEC_NONBLOCK
commands.scope: Use FAN_CLASS_NOTIF, FAN_CLOEXEC and FAN_NONBLOCK and request O_RDONLY and O_CLOEXEC for delivered files.

arch_prctl.limit: Observe the calling thread's FS or GS base through two fixed selectors.

commands.name: ARCH_GET_FS
commands.scope: Return the calling thread's FS base as a number.

commands.name: ARCH_GET_GS
commands.scope: Return the calling thread's GS base as a number.

modify_ldt.limit: Read the calling address space's native local descriptor table into bounded storage.

commands.name: READ_CURRENT_LDT
commands.scope: Use native function zero for a read of at most 65536 bytes.

iopl.limit: Lower the calling thread's emulated I/O privilege to zero.

commands.name: LEVEL_ZERO
commands.scope: Submit fixed level zero without changing independent I/O bitmap permissions.

ioperm.limit: Revoke bitmap permissions in one validated calling-thread port range.

commands.name: TURN_OFF
commands.scope: Submit turn_on zero for a nonempty range within the native 16-bit port space.

reboot.limit: The two admitted returning commands change the Ctrl-Alt-Delete policy.

commands.name: LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_CAD_OFF
commands.scope: Set the Ctrl-Alt-Delete policy to off.

commands.name: LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_CAD_ON
commands.scope: Set the Ctrl-Alt-Delete policy to on.

name_to_handle_at.limit: Query one kernel handle within the exact borrowed owned tmpfs.

commands.name: EMPTY_PATH_UNIQUE_MOUNT_ID
commands.scope: Use AT_EMPTY_PATH and AT_HANDLE_MNT_ID_UNIQUE for the exact resolved regular-file descriptor.

execveat.limit: Use only the empty-path descriptor execution profile with a privately sealed image.

commands.name: AT_EMPTY_PATH
commands.scope: Execute the prepared sealed descriptor. The fork composite uses the same fixed exec flags in the child.

ptrace.limit: One voluntary trace request by the calling tracee for its own parent.

commands.name: PTRACE_TRACEME
commands.scope: Send fixed PTRACE_TRACEME with all auxiliary arguments zero.

kcmp.limit: Compare open file descriptions only within the current process.

commands.name: KCMP_FILE
commands.scope: Use KCMP_FILE for two live borrowed descriptors and expose only equality. The child descriptor acquisition profile uses the same comparison locally to validate ownership.

mq_notify.limit: Register one silent notification or unregister it with a null event pointer.

commands.name: SIGEV_NONE
commands.scope: Register a private fixed native sigevent with SIGEV_NONE without installing a signal or callback.

setns.limit: Join only an exact UTS namespace saved by the provider on the calling thread.

commands.name: CLONE_NEWUTS
commands.scope: Submit fixed CLONE_NEWUTS for the owned saved namespace descriptor.

userfaultfd.limit: Create a nonblocking close-on-exec descriptor for user-mode faults only.

commands.name: USER_MODE_ONLY_NONBLOCK_CLOEXEC
commands.scope: Submit UFFD_USER_MODE_ONLY, O_NONBLOCK and O_CLOEXEC together. Descriptor creation registers no range.

process_madvise.limit: Cover only two advisory hints on a single mapping owned by the calling process.

commands.name: MADV_WILLNEED
commands.scope: Request WillNeed for the complete owned mapping with native flags zero.

commands.name: MADV_COLD
commands.scope: Request Cold for the complete owned mapping with native flags zero.

kexec_file_load.limit: Use the descriptor-based interface only to unload the normal configured image.

commands.name: KEXEC_FILE_UNLOAD
commands.scope: Unload the staged normal image with fixed disabled descriptors and an empty command line.

rseq.limit: Register or unregister exact provider-owned current-thread storage with a null critical-section pointer.

commands.name: REGISTER_FLAGS_ZERO
commands.scope: Register one private native area with flags zero and the native x86 signature.

commands.name: RSEQ_FLAG_UNREGISTER
commands.scope: Remove the exact provider registration using its original area, length and signature.

lsm_set_self_attr.limit: Restrict current-context requests to the fixed AppArmor permission-only check for the existing unconfined profile.

commands.name: LSM_ATTR_CURRENT
commands.scope: Submit only the fixed AppArmor context record for the existing unconfined profile. The typed operation first validates the caller's context.

quotactl.limit: Query only the active quota format of the mounted filesystem selected by a device path.

commands.name: Q_GETFMT
commands.scope: Encode Q_GETFMT with QCMD and the typed user, group or project quota kind. Read one unsigned native format ID without modifying quota configuration.

quotactl_fd.limit: Query only the active quota format of the filesystem selected by a borrowed descriptor.

commands.name: Q_GETFMT
commands.scope: Encode Q_GETFMT with QCMD and the typed user, group or project quota kind. Read one unsigned native format ID without modifying quota configuration.

brk.limit: Observe the current program break using address zero.

commands.name: QUERY_ADDRESS_ZERO
commands.scope: Observe the nonzero native program-break value. The adapter does not request an address change.

fsconfig.limit: Use fixed string settings and create commands only in provider-controlled filesystem context lifecycles.

commands.name: FSCONFIG_SET_STRING
commands.scope: Assign fixed size and mode settings in the owned tmpfs context. The private devpts setup uses the same selector for its fixed mode and ptmxmode.

commands.name: FSCONFIG_CMD_CREATE
commands.scope: Create the configured owned tmpfs tree. The detached procfs and private devpts composites also use this selector for their freshly owned contexts.

epoll_ctl.limit: Change the interest list with the three typed logical transitions.

commands.name: EPOLL_CTL_ADD
commands.scope: Add the exact borrowed watched descriptor with one typed event record.

commands.name: EPOLL_CTL_DEL
commands.scope: Delete the exact borrowed watched descriptor with a null native event pointer.

commands.name: EPOLL_CTL_MOD
commands.scope: Modify the exact borrowed watched descriptor with one typed event record.

ioprio_get.limit: Select the calling task using the native process selector and identifier zero.

commands.name: IOPRIO_WHO_PROCESS
commands.scope: Observe the native I/O priority and decode its class and data.

ioprio_set.limit: Select the calling task using the native process selector and identifier zero.

commands.name: IOPRIO_WHO_PROCESS
commands.scope: Submit only None, Idle or Best Effort with a level from zero through seven.

fanotify_mark.limit: Maintain one inode mark selected by a live descriptor and a typed event mask.

commands.name: FAN_MARK_ADD
commands.scope: Add a single borrowed inode mark with a null pathname and the selected typed mask.

commands.name: FAN_MARK_REMOVE
commands.scope: Remove the exact tracked borrowed inode mark with the same mask and a null pathname.
